content.short: TravelSwap lets you book hotels and flights with Bitcoin, Ethereum and stablecoins.
content.description: TravelSwap is a travel booking site where hotels and flights from major providers can be paid for with crypto, including Bitcoin, Ethereum and stablecoins, with a Pro membership for extra rewards. Stable's official ecosystem page lists TravelSwap.
content.meta: TravelSwap lets you book hotels and flights with crypto and stablecoins, listed on Stable.
